title: g-tee-oh sizing convention spec
description: One sizing_convention spec (R2.9, O-76, O-136), sizes in big blinds (bb).
$comment: gto-tree converts to centi-big-blinds (cbb) and basis points (bp) on a grid.

spec_version.description: The version of this spec format; absent means 1 (O-136).

placeholder_for.description: The game_config a seed placeholder stands in for (R0.6); absent on real rows.

open_bb.description: The open raise size in bb, for example 2.5 (a raise to 250 cbb).

iso_rule.description: The isolation raise over limpers: a base plus an amount per limper.

threebet_ip.description: The 3-bet in position (IP), as a multiple of the raise it answers.

threebet_oop.description: The 3-bet out of position (OOP), as a multiple of the raise it answers.

fourbet.description: The 4-bet as a multiple of the 3-bet it answers; the 5-bet is all-in (O-136).

straddle_bb.description: The straddle in bb, or null (or absent) when the game has no straddle.

limp_positions.description: The seats that may open limp; absent means the small blind only (O-136).

postflop.description: The postflop sizes per street and the tree tuning fields.

config_id.description: A game_config id in gto-model's grammar (O-112, O-132), as in the manifest.

position.description: One of gto-model's nine seat names, as in the manifest (O-132).

positive_bb.description: An amount in bb above zero, on the 0.01 bb (1 cbb) grid.

multiplier.description: A multiple of the raise answered, above 1, on the 0.01 grid.

fraction.description: A size as a fraction of the pot above zero, such as 0.75, on the 1 bp grid.

fractions.description: Pot fractions; empty offers none. gto-tree rejects two in one bucket.

iso_rule.description: Isolation raise size: base_bb plus per_limper_bb for each limper.

base_bb.description: The raise size in bb over one limper, before the per limper part.

per_limper_bb.description: The bb added for each limper, zero or more.

street_fractions.description: One list of fractions of the pot per postflop street.

postflop.description: Bet sizes per street, plus the optional raise and tree tuning fields.

raise.description: Raise sizes per street; absent means raises are all-in only (O-136).

bet_allin.description: Offer an all-in bet beside the sized bets; absent means false (O-136).

raise_allin.description: Offer an all-in raise beside the sized raises; absent means true (O-136).

raise_cap.description: Raises allowed per street, the opening bet not counted; absent means 3.

allin_threshold_pct.description: A size putting in this percent of the stack or more becomes all-in (67).
